notes: Names printed without a suffix (TOWNSHIP, BADER, GILMORE) are written with 'Street'; 'W. McMICKEN AV.' is written 'West McMicken Avenue'. Township (50') comes in at the top left and ends at Cormany (T; Cormany's east line is continuous, Schroth Packing Co. buildings beyond), as on 282. Bader is in two pieces: the west piece (50') runs ENE from Massachusetts (cross; it continues west on 274) past Cormany (T from the north) to the canal, where it ends; the narrow double line across the canal (~11 ft, stairs on the west bank) is a footbridge, not a roadway. The east piece, named 'Bader Street (east of canal)', runs level from Gilmore (T) to West McMicken (T; McMicken's east line continuous); it is offset from the west piece and at a different angle. Gilmore (50' north, 40' printed near its first bend) runs along the canal's east bank, which forms its west line; south of the second bend the canal swings away and the street's centre is taken ~20 ft off the east line, matching the 4in water pipe; it ends at Marshall (T) and continues north off the top (sheet 283). Massachusetts and Marshall cross at the bottom left; Marshall crosses the canal on a bridge (continuous, no end). West McMicken (60') runs from the top (no cross street until Bader) to the SE and leaves the sheet in the binding before Marshall; McMicken/Marshall is off the sheet (computed ~6900,7430) and not recorded. Cormany has no cross streets between Township and Bader. Unnamed 20 ft alley from Bader south to the lot line at y~4921 (dead end). The horizontal lines across block 4 (y~4922, 5154, 5378) are lot lines. The strip beyond the binding on the right (x>6400, 'W. McMICKEN AV.' printed) belongs to the facing sheet and is ignored. Circled figures are grade elevations.
